players.bio: Alfie Sean Devine (born 1 August 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Preston North End.
Alistair Edward McCann (born 4 December 1999) is a professional footballer who plays for Preston North End, as a midfielder. Born in Scotland, he represents Northern Ireland at international level.

Andrew Martyn Hughes (born 5 June 1992) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a defender for Preston North End. Hughes was a part of the Cardiff City youth system, joining them at the age of 7 before being released at aged 15. Hughes then joined the Newport County Academy and made his Newport County senior debut at the age of 16 on 10 December 2008 in the Conference South league.

Andrew Moran (born 15 October 2003) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Preston North End and the Republic of Ireland national team. Club career Early career Moran was born in the Dublin suburb of Knocklyon, and started out at his local club Knocklyon United.
Andrija Vukčević (Cborn 11 October 1996) is a Montenegrin professional footballer who plays as a left back for EFL Championship club Preston North End.

Bradley Potts (born 3 July 1994) is an English footballer who plays as a midfielder for Preston North End. Potts began his career with Carlisle United and made his professional debut on 11 August 2012 in a 1–0 win against Accrington Stanley in the first round of the League Cup. He made his league debut a week later, playing 90 minutes of a 1–1 draw against Stevenage on 18 August.
Caleb Ryan Wiley is an American professional soccer player who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for EFL Championship club Preston North End, on loan from Premier League club Chelsea.
Callum Joseph Lang is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Preston North End.
Daniel Lønne Iversen (born 19 July 1997) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Preston North End.
Delano Dwayne Burgzorg is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Preston North End on loan from EFL Championship club Middlesbrough.

Graham Alexander is a professional football manager and former player who manages EFL Championship club Preston North End. In a lengthy playing career, Alexander represented Scunthorpe United, Luton Town, Preston North End and Burnley. He also made 40 international appearances for Scotland.
Harrison Thomas Clarke (born 2 March 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL Championship club Preston North End.[
Johnny Kenny is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Preston North End and the Republic of Ireland national team.
Jordan Ben Storey (born 2 September 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Preston North End.

Jordan Andrew Thompson (born 3 January 1997) is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Preston North End and the Northern Ireland national team. Thompson began his career with Rangers after progressing through the youth teams at Manchester United.
Jusef Erabi is a Swedish footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Preston North End, on loan from Belgian Pro League club Genk.

Lee Anthony Nicholls is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Preston North End. Early life Lee Nicholls was born in Huyton, Merseyside. Club career Wigan Athletic Nicholls signed scholarship forms with Wigan Athletic in the summer of 2009.

Lewis Jack Gibson (born 19 July 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for EFL Championship club Preston North End. Club career Gibson came through the academy of Newcastle United before joining fellow Premier League club Everton in July 2017. On 31 January 2020, Gibson joined League One side Fleetwood Town on loan until the end of the season.

Liam James Lindsay (born 12 October 1995) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a centre back for EFL Championship club Preston North End. Lindsay started his career with Partick Thistle, and has also played for Alloa Athletic and Airdrieonians on loan.

Max Riley Wilson (born 30 January 2007) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker or attacking midfielder for National League North club Chorley on loan from Preston North End. Born in England, Wilson has represented Northern Ireland at youth level.
Odeluga Joshua Offiah (born 26 October 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back or centre-back for EFL Championship club Preston North End.
Pol Valentín Sancho (born 21 February 1997) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right back for English club Preston North End.
Stanley Mills is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Preston North End.

Thierry Small (born 1 August 2004) is an English footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL Championship club Preston North End. Small became the youngest player in Everton's history in January 2021, aged 16 years and 176 days, but turned professional with Southampton shortly after turning 17.
